data.name: PageTitle
data.value: Netto: keep more of what your SRL earns

data.name: HeroLede
data.value: Netto works out how a Belgian SRL owner-director should pay themselves: director pay or dividends, the allowances and benefits the company can carry, and the advance payments that avoid a surcharge. The result is a plan for your year, move by move.

data.name: TrustPrivate
data.value: Your figures never leave your browser

data.name: TrustTraceable
data.value: Every figure traced to its rule

data.name: PlanCardLabel
data.value: An example of the plan Netto builds

data.name: PlanMoveRent
data.value: Rent your home office to the company

data.name: PlanMoveAdvance
data.value: Spread advance payments over the year

data.name: PlanCardNote
data.value: Illustration. Netto computes your plan from your own figures.

data.name: LeversTitle
data.value: Every lever a one-person SRL can pull, weighed together.

data.name: LeversIntro
data.value: Each choice changes the others. Netto tests them as one system and keeps the combination that leaves the most in your pocket.

data.name: LeverPayText
data.value: The split between director pay and VVPRbis dividends, including the minimum pay that keeps the reduced corporate tax rate.

data.name: LeverCostsText
data.value: Flat-rate allowances, rent for your home office, a company car and meal vouchers, each where you qualify.

data.name: LeverAdvanceText
data.value: What the company and you should pay in advance, and when, to avoid the surcharge without paying early.

data.name: LeverReserveText
data.value: Keep a cushion in the company, as an amount or as months of running costs, and pay out the rest in the best way.

data.name: StepDescribeText
data.value: Expected turnover and costs, what you pay yourself today, and the statuses your company holds.

data.name: StepOptimiseText
data.value: It weighs corporate tax, personal tax and social contributions together, and keeps what leaves you the most this year.

data.name: StepActText
data.value: Every move with what it saves you, and a calendar of what to pay and when.

data.name: PrinciplesTitle
data.value: Built to be trusted with your numbers.

data.name: PrinciplePrivateText
data.value: Netto runs entirely in your browser. There is no account, and your figures are never sent anywhere.

data.name: PrincipleSourcesText
data.value: Every rate and ceiling comes from the tax administration, the Moniteur belge or INASTI, with its reference.

data.name: PrincipleAdviceText
data.value: Netto shows you the numbers. Check your plan with your accountant before you act on it.

data.name: CtaBandText
data.value: Describe your company's year and see the plan Netto builds from it.
